title: The app keeps closing / cloud sync fails. / lack some important features
body:
I. Sync is failing:
I spent 2 hours setting up a shared todo list.
1. I explicitly clicked the sync button a couple of times and the message was “up-to-date”
2. On signing out I got a sync warning, but I continued, because I was convinced that the sync was completed and my collaborator was able to see  the latest changes in my shared list.
3. After log in initially I wasn’t able to see the list at all. Then logged out and logged in again - the list is now visible, but no tasks in it.
This issue renders the app unusable for me.

II. The app was shutting down multiple times during the setup of the tasks, on different screens of the UI. The phone got really hot as well. I assume that there might be a bug that’s sucking up CPU / memory or both.

III. The different views of the tasks lack different options for filtering and sorting e.g. My Day allows you to sort alphabetically, but doesn’t allow you to filter only the tasks assigned to you.

title: Does only basic stuff well
body:
Basic stuff (tasks creation and grouping) works fine, but there are important details that are under thought once you try just slightly more advanced usage. E.g. shared lists of tasks can have tasks assigned to you and others that are not. However there is no full list of your tasks that works logically - the “tasks” list does not show tasks that are in lists, while “assigned to me” does not show tasks that are not in shared lists - so no way to really short list all your tasks - clumsy!

P. S. Decreased my score further - widgets forget the list they are attached to.
